**Test image analysis:**
- Corn ear completely opened, interior replaced by dark black/brownish fragmented mass — teliospore masses
- No normal kernels visible anywhere
- Husks are bleached tan/dry
- Reddish stalk visible above the ear

**Key distinction — Head smut vs Common smut:**
- **Common smut**: discrete fleshy white-to-gray galls on individual kernels/plant parts that turn black
- **Head smut**: entire ear filled with teliospores, teardrop-shaped, husks filled with dark spore mass (no fleshy galls) — this matches perfectly

The Head smut reference image (bottom-right quadrant) shows exactly this pattern: an opened ear with bleached husks and dark interior teliospore mass, identical to the test image.
